Hi Aanya — glad it landed in your account. A few quick activation nudges to help get meaningful usage without heavy lift: 

1) Run a 10-minute smoke test: use the "summarize" prompt on a 2–3 document batch (set max tokens 256). That usually shows value quickly.
2) Turn on streaming in the SDK to reduce perceived latency in the demo.
3) If you have a small labeled eval set, run 20 examples through the same prompt to compare variants — this is very convincing for PMs.

Promo tracking: the promo will appear on your account billing page as "Promo: SEED-45321-SELF" and a remaining balance. We'll also send a 7-day expiry warning when 10 days remain.

If useful, I can schedule a 20–30 minute call this week to run through one of your prompt flows and a short checklist. Attaching a quick usage snapshot I pulled and our onboarding slides to help your team get started.

Attachments: [attachment: seedspark_usage_snapshot.csv (CSV, 12 KB)], [attachment: onboarding-slides.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB)]
